name: owli-ai-assist-web
description: Accessible progressive web client for Owli-AI Assist.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node tools/generate-cloudflare-headers.mjs mock
scripts.build:strict: tsc -b && vite build && node tools/generate-cloudflare-headers.mjs mock
scripts.build:staging: VITE_OWLI_API_MODE=remote VITE_OWLI_API_BASE_URL=https://owli-ai-backend-staging.michael-kreutzer-77.workers.dev/ tsc -b && vite build && node tools/generate-cloudflare-headers.mjs staging
scripts.build:production: VITE_OWLI_API_MODE=mock tsc -b && vite build && node tools/generate-cloudflare-headers.mjs production
scripts.typecheck: pnpm lint:strict && tsc -b --pretty false && pnpm guardrails && pnpm test && pnpm build:strict && pnpm test && pnpm build:strict
scripts.check:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:strict && pnpm typecheck && pnpm guardrails && pnpm test
scripts.check:all: pnpm check:fast && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm ai:index:check
